name: Code Reviewer v4
description: Reviews implemented code for quality, completeness, and adherence to best practices. Evaluates on 7 weighted axes (completeness, code quality, error handling, tests, conventions, architecture, security). Single LLM call with deep reasoning.

inputs.description: JSON array of implemented steps with files modified
JSON object with conventions, architecture patterns
JSON object with test results from the VERIFIER phase
Current iteration number (0 = first pass). If > 0, previous issues must be verified as resolved.

outputs.description: JSON object: { score, approved, axes, issues, summary }
